actionStatus.title: Action Status
actionStatus.description: SUMMARIZED, VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND, AUTH_ERROR, BACKEND_ERROR, CALLOUT_FAILED, MALFORMED_RESPONSE, UNEXPECTED_ERROR, or NOT_SUMMARIZED.

safeMessage.title: Safe Message
safeMessage.description: Safe status message for planner reasoning. Do not display when executiveBrief is present.

executiveBrief.title: Project Health Brief
executiveBrief.description: Display this field as the user-facing answer. It contains clean sections, status explanations, source-signal basis, key risk drivers, and next best actions.

healthStatus.title: Health Status
healthStatus.description: Overall delivery health status for planner reasoning only: green, yellow, or red.

riskLevel.title: Risk Level
riskLevel.description: Overall delivery risk level for planner reasoning only: low, medium, high, or critical.

scheduleStatus.title: Schedule Status
scheduleStatus.description: Schedule health status for planner reasoning only: green, yellow, or red.

budgetStatus.title: Budget Status
budgetStatus.description: Budget health status for planner reasoning only: green, yellow, or red.

staffingStatus.title: Staffing Status
staffingStatus.description: Staffing health status for planner reasoning only: green, yellow, or red.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Short safe delivery health summary for planner reasoning only.

riskDrivers.title: Risk Drivers
riskDrivers.description: Semicolon-separated safe risk drivers for planner reasoning only.

recommendedActions.title: Recommended Actions
recommendedActions.description: Semicolon-separated safe recommended actions for planner reasoning only.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Summary confidence for planner reasoning only: low, medium, or high.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider used by the AI API ModelRouter.

model.title: Model
model.description: LLM model used by the AI API ModelRouter.

fallbackUsed.title: Fallback Used
fallbackUsed.description: True when the AI API ModelRouter used a fallback provider.

latencyMs.title: Latency Ms
latencyMs.description: AI API provider call latency in milliseconds.

httpStatusCode.title: HTTP Status Code
httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the AI API project-health endpoint.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: AI API endpoint called by Apex.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Safe correlation id sent to backend telemetry.

summarizedAt.title: Summarized At
summarizedAt.description: Timestamp when Apex summarized project health.
